title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for the architecture, operation and development of Cash Access UK ’s data platform, built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure. The role works closely with the Insights & Analysis team, business data owners, the Data Governance Consultant, Technology Operations, suppliers and the Head of Data and Technology to keep the platform reliable, bring new data into it safely and ensure the data it holds can be trusted for reporting and decision making.
The platform brings together data from the banking hubs, the Post Office and community banking channels, incident and survey systems, reference data, member banks and public data sources. It was built with a delivery partner and is now moving into business-as-usual operation, and the Senior Data Engineer takes ownership of it as that transition completes, including the runbook, documentation, backlog, alerting and recovery arrangements.
This is a hands-on engineering role where design, build and operation sit with the post holder rather than with a supplier. The Senior Data Engineer is accountable for the platform’s data pipelines, data models, databases, APIs and Microsoft Fabric integrations, for the engineering standards that govern how they are built and released, and for reducing the organisation’s reliance on supplier-led development.

Job Title: Senior Electrical Harness Engineer

 

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

 

Why 9 Mothers?

While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month-not next year-this is your playground.

 

Position Summary

EDDA's cables are its nerves, and we're hiring the person who owns them: every harness in the product - power, signal, data and fiber - from wire list through connector selection, routing across moving axes, bench prototyping, qualification and production sourcing. You have shipped rugged, high-flex-life harnesses and are equally at home with copper, fiber and hybrid builds.

EDDA is the low-cost counter-UAS solution, so the job is one judgment made hundreds of times: rugged where it matters, cost-efficient where it doesn't. MIL-spec circular connectors and continuous-flex cable where a harness crosses the elevation axis and takes recoil; a less-rugged sealed connector and standard jacket where it sits bolted inside the base. You defend each call with test data and a cost roll-up.

 

What You'll Own

- Power: battery, bus and motor-drive feeds - conductor sizing, voltage drop, thermal budgets, fusing, grounding.

- Signal and data: encoder, sensor, CAN, Ethernet, USB and camera links, with the shielding they need.

- Fiber and hybrid: EMI-immune, high-bandwidth links between sensor heads and compute, including copper/fiber hybrids through one rugged connector.

- Moving axes: continuous-flex and torsion-rated cables, service loops, cable carriers and slip-ring interfaces across EDDA's azimuth and elevation joints.

- Connectors and sealing: rugged circular MIL-spec where it earns its place, less-rugged sealed or overmolded connectors where it doesn't.

- Manufacturing and sourcing: formboard drawings, IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship, contract-manufacturer qualification, second sources and cost-down.

 

Essential Duties

- Architect the harness system: turn the electrical architecture into a harness topology - segmentation, connector locations, grounding and shield strategy, service loops and slip-ring boundaries - that is buildable, field-serviceable and cheap to make.

Nous vous proposons d'accompagner notre équipe “Ideate & Achieve”, sur la création de programmes d’intrapreneuriat, ateliers et expériences d’intelligence collective, d’innovation participative et de formations.  

Qui nous sommes :

Chez Artefact Open Innovation, nous sommes des entrepreneurs convaincus que la compétitivité, l’efficacité et la transformation des grandes organisations se gagnent en développant de nouvelles formes de collaborations et une compréhension des enjeux liés à l’adoption des nouvelles technologies - notamment DATA et IA.

Pour cela, nous partageons et propageons l’esprit entrepreneur avec des modes de collaboration plus agiles à l’échelle :

• Des individus, à travers des programmes de formation et l’accélération de projets d’innovation,

• Des équipes, grâce à des expériences d’innovation participative et l’adoption de nouveaux modes de collaboration,

• Des écosystèmes et des organisations, en créant et animant de larges communautés ouvertes (open innovation), mobilisées autour d’objectifs communs

description:
P-1327

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems - from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

Founded by engineers, Databricks has started a multi-year journey to build the best Lakehouse Platform. For this we are building on top of a great foundation but our goal is to go further to build dramatically better products. We want to revisit every component to provide our customers with the fastest, easiest to use and most secure data platform for all their data workloads.

As a software engineer, you will join as a founding member of not only the Berlin site, but really as a founding team for our multi-year journey to achieve our Lakehouse vision. You will be involved in the entire development cycle and exemplify all core Databricks values.

The impact you'll have:

Our backend teams span many domains across our essential service platforms. For instance, you might work on challenges such as:

• Problems that span from product to infrastructure including: distributed systems, at-scale service architecture and monitoring, workflow orchestration, and developer experience.

• Build reliable, secure and high performance services and client libraries for storing and accessing humongous amount of data on cloud storage backends, e.g., AWS S3, GCS, Azure Blob Store.

• Develop product features that empower our customers to easily store and access their data.

What we look for:

• BS (or higher) in Computer Science
